title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure and Patch Handoff Workflow
goal: Add a workflow for responsibly handling suspected novel vulnerabilities: evidence packaging, maintainer handoff, embargo tracking, patch task creation, and report-safe language.
scope: AI research results, reporting, Codex task creation, audit trail, and documentation for responsible disclosure handling.
generation_reason: If AegisPT gains stronger AI vulnerability research features, it also needs a disclosure and patch handoff workflow so novel findings are handled safely and responsibly.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Create disclosure and patch handoff governance only. Do not publish vulnerabilities or contact external parties automatically.
constraints.operator_review_required: All disclosure outputs must remain draft/review state until a human operator approves external communication.

success_criteria: Novel or suspected-zero-day research results can be packaged into a disclosure bundle with evidence refs, affected versions, safe reproduction notes, impact summary, and remediation hypothesis.
Bundles track status such as draft, under review, disclosed, patched, rejected, or embargoed.
The workflow can create a Codex patch/test task for owned code without touching live runtime.
Reports use safe language that avoids public exploit details when disclosure is pending.
Audit events record who created, reviewed, and changed disclosure status.

acceptance_criteria: Disclosure bundles are draft-only and operator-reviewed.
Report output suppresses exploit details for pending disclosure cases.
No external notification, publication, live scan, or runtime mutation occurs automatically.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.
